svg.title: Plain files: Warden against nginx
svg.desc: Bar chart of server CPU per request for plain files, Warden against nginx 1.24: 1.5 KB page 8.19 against 11.28 microseconds (27 percent less), 20 KB stylesheet 8.60 against 10.58 (19 percent less), 100 KB script 18.19 against 18.58 (level). Requests per second are shown beside each bar.

svg.text: Server CPU per request, bars start at zero, shorter is better. One worker each, no response cache.
